answer: The nebula explorer exposes the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the dawn binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 6 separate vaults requires a separate funded dune account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. A 484 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
